rule: Assign type roles with explicit size, leading and weight; validate the research starting profile.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use 12/16 meta, 14/20 body, 18/24 section and 24/32 title as Proposed starting values.
dont: Flatten title and body into identical text.
source_quote: Use role-based sizes and line heights, not one ratio applied indiscriminately.
check: Inspect role tokens, font loading, heading/body contrast and 200% text.

rule: Use a coherent spacing scale that includes 12px and documented optical exceptions.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
dont: Reject 12px solely because it is not on an 8px grid.
source_quote: Use a coherent spacing system with useful intermediate steps.
check: Run check-tokens; inspect shared edges and group spacing.

rule: Map palette shades to semantic roles before assigning component colors.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Define surface, text, border, focus, action and status roles.
dont: Give every nav item a competing accent box.
source_quote: Build neutral, primary and semantic scales rather than selecting five unrelated swatches.
check: Audit undeclared colors and actual foreground/background contrast.

rule: Specify the analytical question and data before choosing the required dashboard chart.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Time trend: line. Category comparison: bars. Exact lookup: table.
dont: Replace a required chart with decorative KPI cards.
source_quote: Choose a chart from the analytical question.
check: Record question, source, units, range, aggregation and encoding; inspect plotted values.

rule: Declare width, content and responsive behavior for each table column.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Set minimum/preferred width, growth, formatting and full-value access.
dont: Split names or status words to fit a context rail.
source_quote: Define content and width behavior for every column.
check: Stress long names and large numbers; run mid-word-break and squeezed-columns.

rule: Keep first use, no results and restricted states distinct.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Give each absent-data cause its own explanation and next action.
dont: Use Create for every empty condition.
source_quote: Differentiate first use, no results and no permission.
check: Exercise separate fixtures for first use, filtered-empty and restricted access.

rule: Choose two or three task-relevant references before judging the screen.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Record capture, width, state and contribution for each reference.
dont: Treat a promotional homepage as an observed authenticated app.
source_quote: A small annotated reference set and a coherent visual contract. This is the proposed missing bridge between ShipRight's product planning and component generation.
check: Compare matched screenshots; unavailable reference evidence stays Not verified.

rule: Allocate the dashboard to the question, visualization and underlying action.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Give the main decision readable space and link overview to records.
dont: Force an empty context rail beside a squeezed table.
source_quote: Prioritize the question and action, not a fixed row of KPI cards.
check: Map regions to requirement IDs; inspect chart and queue in the first working viewport.

rule: Review title, section, body and meta roles on the populated screen.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use role tokens and weight to establish reading order.
dont: Assume unusual fonts make a screen better.
source_quote: Use role-based sizes and line heights, not one ratio applied indiscriminately.
check: Compare computed roles and screenshots against the chosen references.

rule: Make product, workspace scope and active destination identifiable.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use restrained chrome and clear labels with a distinct workspace switch.
dont: Use saturated boxes around every navigation destination.
source_quote: Navigation should identify product, scope and destination.
check: Identify product, workspace and active section from each captured state.

rule: Treat compact density as coordinated padding, row pitch and type.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Keep records readable while tuning repeated row geometry.
dont: Shrink text to fit every column beside a rail.
source_quote: Density is a coordinated component setting, not smaller text.
check: Record visible rows, padding and line counts at phone and desktop widths.

rule: Preserve ordinary table words and provide access to truncated values.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use selective nowrap or ellipsis and keyboard/touch detail access.
dont: Apply break-all to human names and statuses.
source_quote: Truncate selectively and preserve access to the full value.
check: Run geometry checks on longest values; open full values without hover.

rule: Give missing fields product semantics without destroying zero or false.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use Unassigned for missing owners and preserve real numeric zero.
dont: Leak None, null, undefined or NaN into data cells.
source_quote: Missing values require product semantics, not raw serialization.
check: Test null, undefined, empty, zero, false, not applicable and failed retrieval separately.

rule: Implement the required chart from its question and data contract.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Label units, range and sample data; share formatters.
dont: Use a decorative curve to satisfy chart presence.
source_quote: Choose a chart from the analytical question.
check: Check required chart presence, then verify actual encoding and values manually.

rule: Transform global navigation deliberately on phones; keep peer tabs related.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use a drawer or contained tab scroller with a visible linked hint.
dont: Clip the last tab without a way to discover and reach it.
source_quote: Use tabs for related peer views and transform navigation deliberately on smaller screens.
check: Run nav-scroll-hint; reach the last item by keyboard and touch.

rule: Use motion for state and continuity while routine work stays usable.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Specify purpose, interruption and reduced-motion fallback.
dont: Animate every data row on each refresh.
source_quote: Use motion to communicate state and continuity, not delay routine work.
check: Exercise mid-animation input and reduced motion with essential text preserved.

rule: Review tables with difficult content before calling craft complete.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Capture long names, large/negative amounts and dense statuses.
dont: Validate only short empty fixtures.
source_quote: Define content and width behavior for every column.
check: Run mid-word-break and squeezed-columns; inspect captures at 390 and 1280.

rule: Check rendered data for raw serialization and meaningful missing-value labels.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Use formatters that distinguish missing, false, zero and retrieval failure.
dont: Globally replace every false-like value with a dash.
source_quote: Missing values require product semantics, not raw serialization.
check: Run raw-data-value and formatter cases; verify failures are not shown as zero.

rule: A required dashboard visualization cannot disappear inside an average score.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Compare chart, question and actionable records against the brief.
dont: Award craft points merely for chart count.
source_quote: Prioritize the question and action, not a fixed row of KPI cards.
check: Fail missing required charts; verify labels, units, source and task relevance.

rule: Inspect the implemented type hierarchy and real text wrapping.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Compare roles and reference screenshots at matched widths.
dont: Treat a token list as proof of good typography.
source_quote: Use role-based sizes and line heights, not one ratio applied indiscriminately.
check: Run weak-type-scale; inspect actual font loading and hierarchy before accepting a warning.

rule: Keep product, visual and technical judgments separate and evidence based.
why: A visible craft defect must be checked separately from planning completeness.
do: Score five visual categories 0/1/2 with screenshot regions and limitations.
dont: Let process scores average away unreadable tables or missing charts.
source_quote: Proposed ShipRight policy: require usable core tasks, acceptable visual review and no unresolved release-blocking defects.
check: Self-critique against two or three references; fix and rescore to 8/10 with no blocker.
